title: hypericum fasciculatum var. aspalathoides
intro: Hypericum fasciculatum var. aspalathoides, commonly known as California St. John's Wort, is a perennial shrub native to the southwestern United States. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve mood, and alleviate anxiety due to its antidepressant properties. The therapeutic actions of California St. John's Wort include its antiviral, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including hypericin, hyperforin, and flavonoids. These bioactive constituents may help to protect against oxidative stress and promote wound healing, while also exerting a sedative effect to calm the nervous system.
